# a placeholder denylist that was missing the en dash

`isFilled` was a set of 8 known placeholder strings. It held the em dash and not the en dash
-- and the writer itself emits an em dash for empty fields.

So `proof: --` (en dash) read as a real, filled-in value. So did `(none)`, `<tbd>`, `...`,
and a one-letter typo of the writer's own placeholder text.
